decisions.reason: The accelerator program is cheap to maintain and visibly promoted on the home page, but it sits furthest from the core machinery business, so its persistence is the most uncertain.

Presented as a flagship of the firm's direction toward CO2-negative circular materials, the bitumen binder carries public commitment and development investment that management will want to justify, attributing slow uptake to early-market conditions.
The WASTX Cleanic is a publicly announced flagship built with partner ERMAFA, close to core competencies, and backed by sunk co-development costs, so management will persist with it.
The mobile SNOWFLAKE plant fits directly into the core decentralized-recycling offering and the modular WASTX line, making it central to the announced strategy and unlikely to be dropped.
